name: unreal
description: Drive Unreal Engine with your AI coding agent via unreal-mcp-cli: create a project, install the plugin, log in, and open the editor connected to ai-game.dev — automatically.

interface.shortDescription: Create, connect & build Unreal games with AI via ai-game.dev.
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex to drive Unreal Engine end to end through the unreal-mcp-cli npm package: scaffold a project, install the Unreal-MCP plugin, log in to ai-game.dev, open the editor in Cloud mode, confirm the connection, and wire the project's MCP tools — so you can build an Unreal game just by asking.
defaultPrompt: Set up a new Unreal game with AI and connect it to ai-game.dev.
Open my Unreal project with AI and wire up the MCP tools.
